verdict.rationale: The official GitHub repo documents a first-party `zcode` command. Run with no arguments it opens a terminal TUI agent; `--web` starts the web UI with workspace, port, host and token flags; other arguments go to the Agent CLI. An install script creates the `zcode` command in `~/.local/bin` (zcode-gh-1/2/3/4/10). One HN comment calls ZCode GUI-only, but others in that thread were only asking whether a CLI exists. That is not a concrete hands-on failure and likely predates the documented CLI, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of the Agent CLI's own subcommands and headless/scriptable usage, and independent hands-on corroboration that the CLI works.
